findings.evidence: `rg` finds this declaration only at line 113, while Mathlib uses `Commute.all` throughout for arbitrary elements of commutative rings.

summary: The PR adds one public theorem directly covered by the resulting commutative-ring API and one unnecessary private specialization of an existing TauCeti theorem.
